name: Run security and redaction regressions
Check added source for bounded secret patterns
Check the target diff and lint changed sources
command:
set -euo pipefail
git diff --check "$BASELINE_SHA" "$TARGET_SHA"
changed_sources=()
while IFS= read -r file; do
  [ -n "$file" ] && changed_sources+=("$file")
done < <(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR "$BASELINE_SHA" "$TARGET_SHA" -- '*.js' '*.mjs' '*.ts' '*.tsx')
test "${#changed_sources[@]}" -gt 0
pnpm exec eslint "${changed_sources[@]}"
